component.name: sdtv
component.summary: Steam Deck–first IPTV player with controller-native navigation

description.p: sdtv is a media player for Linux and Steam Deck. Add your own Xtream Codes server URL, username, and password to browse live TV with a TiviMate-like interface designed for gamepad navigation in Steam Game Mode.
This application does not provide, host, or distribute any channels, playlists, or media content. You must supply your own provider credentials.
Initial scaffold: controller playground and project structure.
